system.description:
A true sorcerer is untouchable by swords, arrows, spears and fists. Turn Aside the Blade increases the obstacle to strike or shoot the caster. The obstacle penalty is 1 plus the margin of success of the spell. Thus, if a sorcerer casts the spell with five successes, all incoming attacks are at +2 Ob.

Obstacle: 4^. Actions: 11.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Caster | Element: Anima/Earth | Impetus: Control | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 16

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 220
